children.title: Your Room - The Penthouse
children.subtitle: Everything you need to settle in
children.body: Every detail has been applied to the highest specification to immerse you in total luxury. Dark, warm tones; American walnut panelling; Lutron scene lighting. Press the scene buttons by the door to set the mood.
facts: Super king size bed with cotton robes in the wardrobe
Scene lighting — Relax, Bright, Night and Off by the bedside
Rainfall shower and complimentary Alchemist toiletries
AirPlay: your Apple TV is ready to stream from your phone
Housekeeping between 10am and 2pm — hang the sign to skip

children.title: Savant
children.subtitle: Entertainment at your fingertips.
children.body: Control the Penthouse TV and audio through the Savant system, using either the interactive remote control or the provided iPad.
facts: One thing worth knowing  - it crashes all the time
TV CONTROL : Control the Penthouse TV from the Savant system.
AUDIO CONTROL : Manage the room’s audio from the same system.

children.title: The Firepit
children.subtitle: Wood-smoked sharing plates
children.body: The Firepit is AA 2 rosette modern culinary adventure centred around sharing plates. Group Executive Chef John Bingley's indulgent menu brings together the smoky, barbecue aromas of the American West with the delicately spiced tastes of the Far East.
facts: Sharing plates cooked over open flame
Tasting menu available Thursday to Saturday
Private dining room for up to 14

children.title: Pool, Gym & Treatments
children.subtitle: Hydrotherapy, sauna, gym
children.body: Immerse yourself in our relaxing saline hydrotherapy pool or recline on a nearby lounger. Our twelve-seater jacuzzi enjoys panoramic views over Boughton Golf Club. The gym is set up for general fitness rather than gym bunnies — a curved treadmill, exercise bike, water rower and NOHrD gym wall.
facts: Robes and slippers are in your wardrobe

children.title: Therapy Pool
children.kicker: Pop on your robe and enjoy!
children.body: Hot pools differs from swimming pools simply because they are super heated this means you can indulge in the warmth whilst benefiting from health benefits . The water temperature is usually 33–36ºC. But never mind the health benefits, here at Cave our pool is set up for maximum enjoyment, so whether you are looking to relieve the aches and strains, or simply a relaxation session our combination of pools fits the bill. The pool is exclusively for hotel guests to enjoy.

children.title: In Room Treatments
children.subtitle: One line that sums it up
children.kicker: A short line above the title
children.body:
Relax and unwind in the comfort of your own bedroom! Here at Cave, we provide a fully qualified Reflexologist and Massage Therapist with over 20 years’ experience. Your preferences will be established before treatments commence allowing your treatment to be entirely bespoke to you and your needs.

When you book your treatments.
facts: Please have your reservation confirmation number to hand
Contact Sarah on 07939 208662 to make a booking

children.title: Golf
children.subtitle: Play while you stay
children.body: Set in the picturesque Kent countryside, our 6,591-yard course comprises four par 3s, ten par 4s and four par 5s arranged in two loops of nine holes, starting and finishing close to our traditional Kentish clubhouse. Covered driving range, putting green and short-game practice area.
facts: Hotel guests receive 20% off green fees

children.title: Driving Range
children.subtitle: Golf Practice
children.kicker: A short line above the title
children.body: Cave offers a 15-bay, covered driving range where you can practice your swing and driving accuracy with range targets provided.
